context_parameters.edge_filter: merge each homolog edge then require at least10cM; union eligible edges
context_parameters.ibd0_exclusion: all detected IBD between siblings, including short edges
context_parameters.mask: union of all participating individuals' HBD at each fixed cutoff
context_parameters.zero_exposure: IBD011 ratio, numerator and denominator are zero; union remains measurable
context_parameters.selection: single fixed diagnostic; all results reported, no outcome-selected feature/model variant
context_parameters.scope: training only fitting, four separate calibration cohorts, exposed8 development only

strict_development_audit.scope: Development launch guard, not scientific qualification
strict_development_audit.launch_gate_policy: All nine original gates on54 development cohorts plus calibration min-label recall>=.60/ECE<=.10. Then all nine gates on fresh stress, then all nine on fresh confirmation. No parameter changes, refits or exclusions after development.

limitations: Packaging a fixed model does not select the final submission or certify independent confirmation.
Any failed strict development gates are retained verbatim in the bound raw audit.
Corrected finite synthetic templates cover1–4 member branches and varied inbreeding/populations, not all dog pedigrees.
True phase, MCAR missingness and coalescent founder assumptions limit transfer.
Classifier probabilities are synthetic-domain estimates, not validated dog pedigree posteriors.
Final single-submission selection remains root-owned and must not use final-score feedback.
